speaker: richard_quiney
text: Will. Sit. The wine is mine. The answer is yea.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Granted, or gathered?

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Granted. The paper may go through the shires now. What comes back is another matter. I will not call a seal a purse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then say granted, and leave it. I did not walk to Carter Lane to be told a hope.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: And I'll not sup on a debt. Here is a pound of the August two, before the capon is carved. Count it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One pound. I have counted it. Of the August two, you owe one pound still.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: One pound. I said I would not make the supper a forgiveness. The capon, and spiced ale, and the wine as I promised, because the answer is yea.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You said you would make the house better in the telling. Tell it. I will know what to believe.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Your father was up a ladder at the new barns, past sixty, giving orders, and the men obeyed them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Past sixty, on a ladder, and the men obeyed. I will not add a fall to a story that did not have one.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: There was no fall. He came down when the work was said. I am not bringing you a hurt to season a supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will take the ladder, and the orders, and the men who obeyed. Go on.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: The elder girl reads to the Sadlers of a Sunday. They set her a chair, and they listen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Of a Sunday. To the Sadlers. I will not ask what she read.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: I did not ask either. A man who asks the chapter is trying to own the afternoon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we will not own it. The younger.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: She sang at the Hallowmas supper, and they asked her twice. The second time she did not pretend she had not heard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Asked twice is the news. I will not make a voice out of a supper I was not at.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: The boy ran a message to Shottery and back while I was still finding my hat. He was home before the hat was.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shottery and back, and you still at the peg. You have improved the story. I will take the telling. I will not add to it.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Improved, and the things were there. The ladder was there. The chair was there. The song was asked. The hat was mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the capon. The purse can wait until the bird is carved. I am not counting the rest of the money over a bone.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Carved, then. The wine stays mine. You have heard the house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have heard the house. Eat. The town can have its minute when the plate is clear.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: The plate will clear. I am not a man who writes with a knife in his hand.
